# FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] x_PricingCurrencyRate gives the price of an Atlas Credit in billing currency; retain it when reconciling credit consumption with currency costs. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas documents FOCUS 1.3 exports; a MongoDB feedback administrator announced the launch on August 19, 2026. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-19) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits · also: https://feedback.mongodb.com/ideas/CUSTOMER-I-8495
- [statement] BilledCost and EffectiveCost are in billing currency; PricingCurrency can be Atlas Credits. PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost preserves cost in pricing currency, consistent with FOCUS's virtual-currency model. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits · also: https://focus.finops.org/docs/specification/v1-3/columns/cost-and-usage/pricing-currency-effective-cost/
- [statement] Atlas maps legacy CSV Amount and JSON totalPriceCents to PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost; CSV Unit Price and JSON unitPriceDollars map to PricingCurrencyListUnitPrice. These are documented field correspondences, not proof of identical numeric units. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] ContractApplied associates usage with the Atlas Credit covering it; Atlas describes identifying Prepaid, Promotional and Elastic credit types through this field. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] FOCUS 1.3 defines PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost after discounts and allocated prepaid purchases, denominated in PricingCurrency; it must be zero on prepaid-purchase or previous-usage purchase rows. (low confidence) — https://focus.finops.org/docs/specification/v1-3/columns/cost-and-usage/pricing-currency-effective-cost/
- [statement] BillingAccountId/Name identify the Atlas organization; SubAccountId/Name identify its project. Preserve these dimensions for allocation of credit-funded usage. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Atlas FOCUS excludes commitment shortfalls, taxes, adjustments and refunds; pending-month credit assignments remain provisional until invoice close. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] Legacy usage CSV can include a negative Amount credit row. Invoice documentation treats CSV FOCUS as a separate export, so do not assume legacy credit-row handling transfers unchanged. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md
- [statement] FOCUS pricing-currency fields support virtual currencies such as credits and tokens, allowing normalized currency reporting while retaining pricing context; CloudHealth describes this motivation independently. (high confidence) — https://focus.finops.org/docs/specification/v1-3/columns/cost-and-usage/pricing-currency-effective-cost/ · keywords: FOCUS column mapping for Atlas credits · also: https://community.broadcom.com/blogs/tj-march/2026/01/06/unpacking-finops-x-2025?CommunityKey=1160f3d8-dc82-42c5-a652-01993ed19f37
- [statement] Vantage's public Costs to FinOps FOCUS converter lists MongoDB as requesting sample invoices to build support; this scopes that converter's coverage, not Atlas's native export availability. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://focus.vantage.sh/
